experiment: QNN Owen values with qubit_role coalition structure
alpha_note: alpha=1.0 evaluates the full structured Owen coalition space for these small partitions; K still averages shot noise.

partition_semantics.Q0: local gates acting on measured/readout qubit q0
partition_semantics.Q1: local gates acting on hidden/unmeasured qubit q1
partition_semantics.2Q: two-qubit CX gates that couple readout and hidden paths
partition_semantics.Q1F: final local rotation on q1; expected to be close to irrelevant for q0 readout

value_function: one-shot test accuracy; first-qubit readout; no retraining
estimator_note: For each Owen visit (R,T), v(Q_R union T) and v(Q_R union T union {i}) are each evaluated K fresh times; the two K-means are differenced and then averaged over visits.
